title: No test checks the Hevy and Strong import stays on the phone
what: The import screen promises that everything is processed on the phone and nothing is uploaded. No test checks those words, that the export file is never sent anywhere, that a Hevy link sends nothing of the member's to Hevy, or that imported weights and notes never reach the gym.
expected: A test that runs an import and a Hevy link read and checks no member data leaves the phone, plus a check of the promise words on screen.
fix_line: Add a test that watches the network during an import and checks the promise words

title: The import result, date question and error words are never checked on screen
what: Phone tests stop at the '12 workouts imported' title. The 'Workouts added', 'Sets logged' and 'New exercises created' rows, the 'Answer the date question first' button, the 'Demo removed, history imported' bar, the failure line and the 'That isn't a Hevy share link' line are never seen. The unit tests check only the reader's logic.
expected: Phone or screen tests that see the result rows, the date question blocking Import, the demo bar and each error line.
fix_line: Add the missing checks to the import phone flows

title: The join screen's line on what the gym sees is never tested
what: Joining a gym shows 'Your gym sees how many workouts you log and the weight you lift, for challenges...' and, with the trainer view on, a second line that the gym and trainer see the workouts. No test checks the first line, or that the two lines never say opposite things.
expected: The invite phone flow checks the gym-sees line, and a trainer-view gym's join screen is checked for both lines.
fix_line: Add both lines to the invite phone flow

title: The invite screen's not-found card, Try again and the fresh-phone path are never driven
what: A wrong or old invite code, the 'Try again' button after an error, and a link tapped on a brand-new phone that must open the join screen after the welcome steps are tested only as data. No phone test shows any of them.
expected: Phone flows for a wrong code, a failed gym lookup with Try again, and an invite link opened before setup.
fix_line: Add phone flows for the wrong code, the retry and the fresh phone

title: The own-exercise form's warnings are never tested
what: No test types a name that already exists ('Already in your library'), sees 'Saved, but not added' from a routine, picks a video that is too large, opens an empty Hidden exercises list, edits an exercise that has sets, or double-taps Save.
expected: Tests for each of these warnings and for one save per double tap.
fix_line: Add screen tests for the form's warnings

title: The Add measures refusals and the replace question are never tested
what: No test saves an empty form ('Nothing to save'), a 0 ('Check the numbers'), or a weigh-in on a day that already has one ('Replace it with this one?'). The 'Replaced the entry on' bar, the gym entries' History heading and the two-day chart are never seen either.
expected: Screen or phone tests for each refusal, the replace question with its undo bar, the gym entries' heading and the chart.
fix_line: Add tests for the Add measures refusals and the replace question

title: The 1-rep max screen is never opened in a test
what: Only the sums are tested. No test opens the screen, sees the boxes filled from the best recent set, the refusal words, or that a free member is sent to MettleUp Plus. No test checks that the fill does not overwrite what the member typed when sets load late. The sums test has no warm-up set, so it cannot show warm-ups are skipped.
expected: A screen test of the calculator: the fill, typing over it, each refusal, and the Plus lock.
fix_line: Add a screen test for the calculator and a warm-up case to the sums test

title: Deleting, comparing and the backup line on Progress photos are never tested
what: No test deletes a progress photo ('Delete this photo?'), checks it leaves the grid, Compare and the backup, sees the 'Tap the first photo' prompts or 'Photos not found', or sees the 'in your phone's backup too' subtitle when photo backup is on. The phone test checks only that the 'no share list' line is absent.
expected: Phone or screen tests for delete, the compare prompts and gone-photo page, and the backup-on subtitle.
fix_line: Add a delete and a backup-on step to the photos phone flow

title: Saving a plan without following it, and a failed save, are never tested
what: The phone flows always tap 'Save and follow' or 'Follow this plan'. No test saves a built plan or a program while keeping the current plan, no test makes saving fail ('Could not save the plan', 'Could not add the program'), and no test opens the Hevy or Strong row from Find a plan.
expected: Tests that keep a plan without following it and check the followed plan is unchanged, a save failure that keeps the answers, and the Find a plan import row.
fix_line: Add a keep-only save and a failed save to the plan tests

title: No test checks a plan or a shared routine file carries no personal data
what: Nothing checks that sore areas and the plan stay on the phone, or that a shared routine file holds only routines and exercises, never the member's name, body weight or history.
expected: A test that makes a routine file from a member with history and body weight and checks the file has none of it; and that building a plan sends nothing.
fix_line: Add a check of the shared file's contents and of no network call

title: Routine file updates and program errors are never seen on screen
what: Tests check the data only. No test sees 'You have this file already' with its two buttons, 'Folder updated' with 'Your changes were kept in', the 'Left out (no muscles in the file)' line, 'Program not found', or 'Already in your routines' with 'Follow it'. No test checks the member's own edits survive an update.
expected: Screen tests for these sheets and lines, and a data test that the member's edited routines are kept on update.
fix_line: Add screen tests for the routine file and program sheets
